scope: New D7 main comparison planned after the earlier exploratory benchmark; never a retrospective preregistration of earlier results

data_contract.target: Population standard deviation ddof=0 of seven daily log close returns; unannualized
data_contract.missing_data: No imputation/calendar compression; exclude dependent windows; abort if the preregistered 60-date evaluation is incomplete

search.evaluation: Mean across two seeds of RMSE pooled over all January-October validation dates; not mean monthly RMSE
search.tie_break: lower parameter count, then candidate_id; family tie alphabetical
search.baseline_selection: Best selected-family CV score; freeze before pilot/test; do not reselect on new reserve
search.monthly_stage_seed: base_seed+100000*month_ordinal, January2024 ordinal0; candidate jobs use the same paired base/month seeds

pilot.policy: Fit before origin, inner chronological selection plus fresh refit; fixed weights for all 60 dates, mimicking final evaluation

definitive.policy: For each registered new seed, inner chronological stopping before origin, then fresh refit on all permitted 2023-2024 development; no 2025-2026 training labels

reserve.prestudy_access: Acquisition traversed raw CSV rows for integrity, timestamp and schema audit. No target, price-performance analysis, training, model selection or evaluation of this reserve was performed by this project, according to preserved records. This is not a never-opened-archive claim.
reserve.allocation: New explicit allocation authorized by the present request; no reassignment of the earlier 2025-August2026 test
reserve.interpretation: Pre-specified evaluation on a historical reserve unused for earlier model results; not a live future forecast or a second independent market
reserve.read_policy: One explicit scoring pass after all registered weights and scalers are frozen; save predictions; analyses reread saved predictions only

statistics.delta_origin: 5% of original GRU/D7 CV RMSE .005154568532996221; academic planning convention fixed before this new phase, posterior to earlier test
statistics.primary_test: Two-sided paired t on matched-seed pooled 60-date RMSE; Holm3; t noncentral dimensioning at conservative Bonferroni alpha=.05/3
statistics.power_scope: At least .80 marginal planning power per comparison under Gaussian independent seed differences and transferred pilot dispersion; not joint power .80, not temporal power or unconditional future-market power
statistics.unit: Independent random initialization/order seed paired across recipes, conditional on the same calendar; do not count days or months as independent seeds
statistics.effect: Paired Cohen d_z plus paired-seed bootstrap sensitivity; zero difference/zero variance handled explicitly
statistics.confidence_intervals: 95% marginal and Bonferroni simultaneous family intervals; intervals conditional on training randomization
statistics.normality: Shapiro-Wilk on paired differences as diagnostic only; report all pre-specified tests, do not switch to the test yielding smaller p

temporal_secondary.loss: Daily MSE averaged across individual seed models, not MSE of averaged predictions
temporal_secondary.temporal_bootstrap: Circular moving blocks, primary length7, sensitivity3/14; 4999 replicates; paired same date resamples all recipes/seeds; preserve mean per-seed RMSE estimand
temporal_secondary.temporal_bootstrap_pairs: The same six explicit temporal-secondary pairs, with paired common date resamples; seed metric aggregation preserved
temporal_secondary.temporal_bootstrap_intervals: 95% marginal and Bonferroni simultaneous six-pair intervals for primary block7; block3/14 are descriptive sensitivity, not new opportunities to choose significance

statistics.practical_relevance: Report zero-difference evidence separately from whether relative improvement exceeds5%; do not equate significance or a favorable point estimate with a confidence bound exceeding the practical threshold

residual_diagnostics.scope: Exploratory residual diagnostics over all 60 dates for each frozen neural seed; not the confirmatory primary family
residual_diagnostics.multiplicity: Holm separately for all3R BDS tests and all6R Ljung-Box tests; undefined tests retained in family; not a nonlinear-gain claim

failure_policy.technical_failures: Stop and preserve original error/artifacts; no replacement of unfavorable seeds; resume only exact registered jobs after root-cause review
failure_policy.missing_reserve_dates: Abort primary analysis rather than silently changing the cohort
failure_policy.degenerate_pilot: Report inability to plan if paired variance cannot be estimated; never substitute an arbitrary successful power
failure_policy.infeasible_sample_size: Report required R and infeasibility; never silently cap R or claim target power
failure_policy.protocol_changes: Any scientific change after results starts a new version; never overwrite frozen protocol

public_export.allowed: Code, preregistration, configurations, aggregate metrics/inference/figures, timestamps and SHA256 manifests
public_export.excluded: Raw minute archives, individual daily observations/predictions, learned scalers and checkpoints

fixed_seed_illustration.rule: First definitive seed; never selected by holdout error
fixed_seed_illustration.format: PNG only; no machine-readable daily observations/predictions
